abstract: Abdominal CT examinations of 40 patients with non-seminomatous testicular tumors were reviewed with previous knowledge of the side of the testicular primary. Metastatic nodes, between 1.5 cm and 2.0 cm in diameter were overlooked more frequently in patients with right than in those with left testicular primaries, because mildly enlarged aorto-caval or para-caval nodes (which are the most frequent site of metastasis from a right testicular lesion) were more difficult to detect than enlarged left para-aortic lymph nodes. Efforts to delineate the aorto-caval region on CT examinations of patients with right-sided lesions must be increased in order to reduce a surprisingly high false negative rate.
abstract_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣腫瘍40例の腹部CT検査を、精巣原発巣の側に関する既知情報を踏まえて再検討した。1.5cmから2.0cmの転移性リンパ節は、左側原発の症例より右側原発の症例で見落とされることが多かった。右側原発からの転移の最も多い部位である大動脈・下大静脈間および傍下大静脈のリンパ節は、左側の傍大動脈リンパ節の腫大に比べて軽度の腫大の検出が難しかったためである。右側病変の症例では、大動脈・下大静脈領域の評価を強化し、驚くほど高い偽陰性率を減らす必要がある。
